title: Hermes Starship · fastpaths
description: The coded fast paths: first words that code routes straight to a station's profile, before Number One reads the message. Hermes keeps them in routing/fast-paths.json, which the arrival hook reads; live/fastpaths.json from the ship probe copies it for the board. Without it the board shows this sample (patch P's words).

words.description: First words, lower case, matched at the very start of the typed text as whole words. A speed word before them still counts as the start.

profile.description: The Hermes profile code files the card for.

example.description: A message that takes this path.
